invented.quote: the 20 generic drugs your members use most
invented.why: The brief says they are the 20 generic drugs the pharmacies fill most overall, not necessarily the ones plan members use most.

invented.quote: more than one in five of our customers is a state employee or a family member of one
invented.why: The brief states that plan members make up about 22% of prescriptions, which does not automatically mean they make up more than 20% of customers.

invented.quote: For the 20 generics we fill most, each one of those prescriptions now costs us more than the plan pays.
invented.why: The brief says the plan pays $1.80 less than cost on average across the 20 drugs, not that every single prescription is paid below cost.

invented.quote: None of us can make it all back
invented.why: The user only stated that some pharmacies make up part of the loss on brand-name drugs and that they do not know by how much.

invented.quote: The July 1 renewal is the one point this year when the plan can fix this.
invented.why: The brief only states that the contract comes up for renewal on July 1, not that it is the only time this year the plan can change the rates.
